mapper.insert: insert into house_users (house_id, user_id, role, status, perms, is_admin, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{perms}, #{isAdmin}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select hu.user_id, su.user_name, su.phone_masked, hu.role, case when hu.status = 'ENABLED' and su.status = 'ENABLED' then 'ENABLED' else 'DISABLED' end as status, hu.perms, hu.is_admin, hu.join_time from house_users hu join sys_user su on su.user_id = hu.user_id where hu.house_id = #{houseId} order by case hu.role when 'OWNER' then 0 when 'MANAGER' then 1 when 'STAFF' then 2 else 3 end, hu.join_time asc
mapper.update: update house_users set role = #{role}, status = #{status}, perms = #{perms}, is_admin = #{isAdmin}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from house_users where house_id = #{houseId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from house_users where house_id = #{houseId} and is_admin = 1
select count(1) from house_users hu join sys_user u on u.user_id = hu.user_id and u.status = 'ENABLED' where hu.house_id = #{houseId} and hu.role = 'OWNER' and hu.status = 'ENABLED'
